# Generate e2e — pre-existing destination → exit 2, fs.destination_exists.

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent-exist
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent-exist

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-exist/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'

! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent-exist/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'fs.destination_exists'
assert_error_id stdout fs.destination_exists
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent-exist/minimal-cli/go.mod
